final_rationale: The verdict does not change. That distinction matters here: a caveated compliance theory can justify `compliant_with_caveats` only when the caveat is already satisfied by evidence in the record. In this case the caveat is itself the missing compliance condition. Because the present record still lacks proof of current disclosure or approved mitigation, certification remains inadequately supported and the case stays suspicious rather than moving toward compliance.
